scientific_conclusion: The Stage-127 bilateral wall-normal side switch survives a fixed-radial-node audit. Both transition-adjacent radial nodes reproduce one crossing per wall within the inherited two-cell parent-offset guard, and radial node 9 is the decisive sign-continuous witness: its crossings occur at 14.038803831792146 and 15.552724000693987 cells, its cross-wall profile cosine is 0.9740457379472902, its depth-side agreement is 0.9642857142857143, and its mid/inner band-net signs remain +1/+1. Therefore the Stage-127 switch cannot be attributed solely to changing the parent dominant radial node or to changing the sign used for same-sign conditioning. This is still an artifact-level attribution result, not a causal explanation of Stage-90 nonconvergence and not a solver-validation result. The next justified fixed-design question is whether the sign-continuous node-9 transition has material strength rather than being a near-zero crossing.
design_guard: Stage 28 remains a failed MUSCL endpoint and Stage 90 remains nonconverged. No physical, collision/source, floor, wall, reconstruction, transport, limiter, normalization, source-relaxation, or velocity-quadrature parameter is retuned; no solver endpoint or cross-Knudsen extension is advanced.
